Maria Accounts: Received an invoice from VertexCloud for March usage but it's weird — totals in EUR, lines reference PO-9921 and PO-9922. Attaching PDF: [vertexcloud_inv_3321.pdf]
vertex-billing: Invoice 3321 uploaded to Procure (vendor_id=VC-12) amount=€12,340.00, lines=compute|storage|support. Link: https://vendor-invoices.example/3321
Devin FinOps: @tia-approvals can you confirm approver for PO-9922? Also do we accept EUR invoices for this vendor or should finance convert?
Tia Approvals: We don't have PO-9922 in Coupa/procure. Looks like vendor used a legacy PO. Can you paste the invoice line detail? Is this for Dedicated capacity?
Samuel Ops: Yep this is Dedicated reserved capacity for the DC cluster. Ops created internal order 2024-DC-77; Procurement only issued PO-9921. Vendor probably pulled an old PO on support.
Maria Accounts: Invoice shows two distinct lines: compute (PO-9921) €9,800 and support (PO-9922) €2,540. Vendor contact claims support belongs to SVC-UX team but SVC-UX has no PO. I've asked vendor for clarification.
Devin FinOps: Ask vendor to reissue with a single PO (9921) or issue a credit note for the support line and re-invoice. If they insist on EUR we'll need FX approval for exposure > €5k — cc @samuel-ops for biz sign-off.
vertex-billing: Apologies, typo on vendor side. PO-9922 was an internal placeholder. We'll reissue invoice referencing PO-9921 and send a credit for the €2,540 support line within 48h. New invoice will be in USD per contract terms.
procure-bot: Invoice 3321 moved to `pending-clarification` queue. Approval routing paused.
Tia Approvals: I'll mark as on-hold until credit note arrives. If reissued invoice not received by Friday we escalate to Procurement.
Devin FinOps: Also note pricing mismatch: support line billed at €0.16/GB but contract shows $0.10/GB. When they reissue please verify unit rates against contract v3.1 — I'll attach the contract snippet here.
Maria Accounts: Contract snippet: ```vendor: vertexcloud
service: support
rate: $0.10/GB (v3.1)```
Samuel Ops: Confirming support should be $0.10/GB. If vendor refuses, we dispute and withhold payment for that line until resolved.
Tia Approvals: @maria-accounts set GL to suspense for disputed amount and code remainder to 6100 (cloud-services).
Devin FinOps: Opening PROC ticket and flagging AP hold. Tagging @procure-bot for routing.
procure-bot: Ticket PROC-2026-451 created, assigned to procurement@redwood.com, SLA=3 business days.
Maria Accounts: Noted. Will update AP ledger and wait for vendor credit/reissued invoice. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
